player_prompt.intro:
A woodere {player_id} e Whist e lesdi German.
{phase_info}
A heɓi {hand_size} kaatu.
Woni kaatu e '[play N]', tee N woni koorde e janngde (e sembe '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: the winner of each trick takes the face-up card and the loser draws the next card from the deck. Tricks won in this phase do not count towards victory.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: Wala kaarji je ɗon hokkaama - feerol fuɗɗi.
next_card.deck_empty: Deck man wala kujeji - walaa kaar je ɗum hokkata.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Naftirol waylitaaki je wala bote. Kuwtinam '[play N]' ngam fija kaadi Nth ha juɗe maaɗa.
invalid_move.bad_position: Ɗo'e dabareji kaadi wala. A ɗon jogii {hand_size} kaaruuji.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: A haani tokkita e waɗugo kaar {lead_suit}.

trick.won_learning: Player {winner_id} wins the trick with {card} and takes the face-up card.

phase.learning_complete: Ko'e maɓɓe fuu ɗon nafo. Wakkere ekkitol timmi - kala dabare je lutti hauti ngam heɓa jaalorgal.

draw.winner_received: A heɓii kuje man, a jaɓi {card}.
draw.loser_received: You lost the trick and drew {card} from the deck.

trick_view.empty: Walaa kujeji je ɗon fija haa jooni.

board_str.header: === GARMAN WHIST Game=== Ɗi ɗon ɓaditoo nder lesdi Germany.
board_str.player_line:
{observation}
Woodere {player_id}: {scoring} koore heewde ({tricks} ngal), {hand_size} kaatu e janngde

outcome.summary: Learning phase - Player 0: {l0}, Player 1: {l1}. Playing phase - Player 0: {p0}, Player 1: {p1}. Player {winner_id} wins with {winner_tricks} scoring tricks!
